segments.name: Retail
segments.description: Boot Barn operates retail stores and an e-commerce platform selling western and work-related footwear, apparel and accessories to consumers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for merchandise purchased at its stores and through its e-commerce channels.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's accounts receivable consist of amounts due from commercial customers for merchandise sold, as well as receivables from suppliers under co-operative arrangements.
